questions.text: What does IP stand for in IP address?
questions.explanation: IP is short for Internet Protocol.

questions.text: What does DNS commonly help a device find?
options: An IP address associated with a domain name
questions.explanation: DNS resolves names to records such as IP addresses.

questions.text: What is a packet in networking?
options: A unit of data sent across a network
questions.explanation: Packets are units used to carry data over networks.

questions.text: Why use domain names rather than require people to memorize numeric addresses?
options: Names eliminate the need for network addresses
DNS turns a computer into a router
Names are easier for people to remember, and DNS helps locate destinations
questions.explanation: DNS makes human-readable names usable for reaching services.

questions.text: What is the role of IP addressing when data travels?
options: It helps network equipment direct data toward an intended destination
It changes every document into a photo
questions.explanation: IP addresses help identify destinations for routed traffic.

questions.text: Why is opening a webpage more than simply "using DNS"?
options: DNS already contains all web pages
DNS assists name resolution; connections and data transfers are still required
No packets are used on the internet
The keyboard sends the whole page
questions.explanation: Resolving the domain is only one stage in accessing a website.

questions.text: A learner sees 192.168.1.25 in device settings. What is it likely to represent?
questions.explanation: 192.168.x.x is within a commonly used private IPv4 range.

questions.text: A site is entered as example.com. Which service is normally consulted to learn its address?
questions.explanation: DNS is used for domain-name resolution.

questions.text: Which sequence best describes simplified website access?
options: Resolve name, connect to server, request content, receive content
Print page, then enable cable, then invent a domain
Request content without any network, then resolve name
Change password, then power off router
questions.explanation: A web request generally uses name resolution and network communication.

questions.text: A browser says a domain cannot be resolved, but other network checks succeed. What should you test?
questions.explanation: A name resolution error points toward DNS-related checks.

questions.text: A device has a private IP but no working default gateway for reaching outside networks. What is the likely impact?
options: All local printers must automatically fail
Local LAN traffic may work while internet destinations fail
DNS names disappear from the web
questions.explanation: A gateway is needed for forwarding traffic beyond the local network.

questions.text: A learner claims an IP address always identifies a particular person. Which response is best?
options: All phones share one permanent public IP
An IP address identifies network connectivity and is not, by itself, proof of a specific person
questions.explanation: Addresses identify network endpoints or interfaces, not reliably individual people.
